body:
泰晤士报Peter Rutzler等人联合专栏：
（其实只有一句话是新的）
-恩佐的谈判在进行，任何转会都可能会超过1.2亿英镑（前提是谈妥），恩佐本人“极度渴望”和马雷斯卡重聚。
-此外，在恩迪亚耶加盟曼城之后，Times这里透露阿森纳和切尔西都关注过恩迪亚耶，但没有实际行动。
（City also hope to add Enzo Fernández to their squad on deadline day in a potential £120million-plus deal with the London club for the 25-year-old Argentina player, who is understood to be desperate to be reunited with his former manager Enzo Maresca at the Etihad. Arsenal and Chelsea were also said to be interested in Ndiaye, who had three years left on his Everton contract. ）
